text:
The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.

Beneath the lamps' ethereal, ghostly gleam,
He walked the streets where silent shadows stream.
Each footfall echoed on the pavement stone,
A solitary rhythm, all his own.

Like phantoms passing, faces turned away,
Lost in the depths of their own private day.
No glance was cast, no word was softly spoken,
In urban tides, his solitude was broken.

Amid the sea of concrete, cold and vast,
He stood apart, a shadow in the past.
A profound isolation, deep and wide,
With nowhere left for his heart to hide.
